title: Weight-derived empty-escape specialization on current QKV GV1/GV8
mechanism: At entry, use the existing warp-uniform first escape sentinel to choose a templated escape-free step loop or the exact old escape loop. Empty-list warps execute identical12-bit decode/MMA/load ordering without the per-unit next-sequence test; nonempty lists preserve every correction. Do not change geometry, W depth, cache policy or arithmetic. Existing SASS already interleaves dec1 operations, so merely reordering four dec1 calls is NOT the proposal.
why_current: Scored QKV1 is GV(1,1,1,2,16,8,1,1,2,1),64registers; QKV8 is GV(1,1,1,1,16,8,1,1,2,8193). Current _gvesc emits32-entry sentinel lists; step checks nx on every K-unit. Exact CUDA empty-list prevalence is not archived and is the first discriminator.
cpu_discriminator: Prove sentinel-uniform branch and identical corrections/math for both paths, including adversarial nonempty escapes and odd M. Compile only these two existing geometries; reject if64-register/two-CTA eligibility is lost or instruction-cache expansion removes the saved path. Count actual prepared empty lists in the next authorized trial before timing.
falsifier: Actual empty lists are rare, generated SASS already hoists the test equivalently, resource/code-size cost dominates, or complete current-policy F1 and paired signed deltas do not improve. Keep every small signed observation.
new_proof: No escape may be omitted based on sampled frequency; sentinel is exact weight-derived metadata. Both warp paths rendezvous through the existing CTA reduction unchanged.
